best_narrative.headline: Zocdoc: Telehealth Competitors Mobilize Federal Lobbying on Prescription Economics
best_narrative.body: Zocdoc operates a marketplace model connecting consumers to providers across categories, including telehealth, creating exposure to both state medical advertising rules and federal anti-kickback enforcement if marketplace incentive structures are scrutinized. Four competitors have filed federal lobbying disclosures on telehealth topics as of May 2026, signaling coordinated industry attention to prescription economics and access policy. Industry-standard regulatory exposures for this business model include state consumer protection enforcement and scrutiny of how marketplace economics influence prescribing patterns. The New York market, where Zocdoc maintains material provider and consumer presence, has shown heightened interest in telehealth advertising compliance and consumer fraud prevention.
